clause: Processing is lawful only if the data subject has given consent.
notes: Matches article 6 in the fake GDPR fixture.

clause: The data subject shall have the right to withdraw consent at any time.
notes: Matches article 7 in the fake GDPR fixture.

clause: The controller must notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within 72 hours.
notes: Matches article 33 in the fake GDPR fixture.

clause: Personal data means any information relating to an identifiable natural person.
notes: Matches article 4 in the fake GDPR fixture.
